tools.name: cliento_list_locations
tools.description: Preview API: Locations accessible to this API key, with name, currency and time zone. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_get_location
tools.description: Preview API: One location, with name, currency and time zone. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_list_staff
tools.description: Preview API: Staff IDs, optional names and linked resource IDs. Omits PIN settings and secrets. Requires staff:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_list_resources
tools.description: Preview API: Bookable resource catalog and online-booking settings; no bookings or availability. Requires resources:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_get_resource
tools.description: Preview API: One resource, including its status and online-booking settings. Requires resources:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_list_resource_groups
tools.description: Preview API: Resource headings in display order. Requires resources:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_list_services
tools.description: Preview API: Service catalog, durations, prices, VAT and per-resource overrides. Omits free-text descriptions. Requires services:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_get_service
tools.description: Preview API: One service and its per-resource overrides, excluding free-text descriptions. Requires services:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_list_service_groups
tools.description: Preview API: Service headings and their add-on marker. Requires services:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_list_resource_services
tools.description: Preview API: Services as this resource offers them, including its duration, price and override settings. Requires services:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_list_products
tools.description: Preview API: Product catalog and current stock balances. Cost fields appear only with stock:cost; omitted balances mean the product is not stock-tracked. Requires products:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_get_product
tools.description: Preview API: One product and its current stock balance, when tracked. Cost fields need stock:cost. Requires products:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_list_stock_movements
tools.description: Preview API: Stock changes, oldest first, omitting comments, visit/external references, colour-mix links and free-text reasons. Movements may appear about ten seconds after creation. Requires stock:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_list_merchants
tools.description: Preview API: Legal sellers at the location, with optional company registration numbers. No payment or gift-card data. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_list_colour_bar_ranges
tools.description: Preview API: Supplier range catalog and pack-size/list-price settings; no personal recipes or colour mixes. Requires products:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_get_colour_bar_range
tools.description: Preview API: One supplier range and its catalog settings; no personal recipes or colour mixes. Requires products:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_list_colour_bar_items
tools.description: Preview API: Shade/item catalog, barcodes and pack balances. Choose at most one of rangeId, ean or articleNumber; no recipe or mix data. Requires products:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

tools.name: cliento_get_colour_bar_item
tools.description: Preview API: One colour-bar stock item and its pack balances; no personal recipes or mixes. Requires products:read. Read-only; this API may change without a version bump.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "cliento_list_staff" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
